meta.scopeWarning: Expenditure in 2019 as printed in the proposed programme budget for 2021 (document A/75/6). Regular budget, other assessed and extrabudgetary resources are added together, but not every section publishes all three. Peacekeeping operations are a separate budget, shown below. 11 rows cannot be drawn (General Assembly, Advisory Committee on Administrative and Budgetary Questions (including its secretariat), Committee on Contributions, Board of Auditors (including its secretariat), United Nations Joint Staff Pension Board (including United Nations participation in the costs of the secretariat of the United Nations Joint Staff Pension Fund), Committee for Programme and Coordination, Secretary-General, Investigation into the conditions and circumstances resulting in the tragic death of Dag Hammarskjöld and of the members of the party accompanying him, Resident coordinator system, Full budget (jointly financed activities): financial resources, Regular budget (United Nations share): financial resources); see the note below.
meta.hierarchyProjection: USD Whole/Part/section hierarchy with RB, OA and XB side by side, followed by one source-role-selected component allocation outline per section/entity. Object, post, duplicate and CHF schedules remain outside additive arithmetic. Selected lower outline: 129 source tables, 864 printed observations and 406 materialized lower nodes; 153 parallel tables and 2 other-currency tables remain outside additive arithmetic.
